currentSource: Korean implementation worktree, staged and working source at measurement time

method.baseline: git archive to /tmp/ko-index-baseline-0306b74; shared read-only node_modules and unchanged public/media
method.comparison: loadContent -> searchDocuments -> createIndex.toJSON -> complete emitter-shaped SearchIndexFile with popular/suggest terms and final newline
method.timing: Single sequential measurement per locale, CPU contention present; timings are diagnostic, not a latency budget pass
method.sameCorpusControl: Current analyzer creates indexes from baseline search documents and compares exact serialized indexes and full responses with baseline analyzer
method.actualArtifactCheck: All current generated index files exactly match reconstructed files after buildId normalization

conclusion.growthExplanation: Only search-document terms changed: 367 English documents and 363 each zh-Hans/ja/de documents gained Korean taxonomy labels/aliases through the pre-existing termAliases cross-language behavior (scripts/lib/content/build-index.ts:335-348). Existing titles, descriptions, bodies, paths, tags and identities are unchanged. Korean aliases add approximately 53 KB raw / 3.5–4.5 KB gzip per locale.
conclusion.rankingDifference: German gpt-image-2 returns the same 298 total and same top-5 members per kind; prompt order changes p_287,p_298,p_297,p_286,p_217 -> p_287,p_298,p_217,p_297,p_286. Same-corpus control reproduces baseline bytes and exact query responses for all four locales, isolating this to taxonomy corpus additions rather than analyzer changes for existing languages.
conclusion.releaseScope: Confirms bounded explained index growth and existing-language analyzer regression control; does not claim browser/network startup or production latency budgets are passed.
